lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Relacionamentos (fall out with, make up, break up with, get on well with, lose touch, look up to).

head: Situação
Expressões
rows: Começar

meet (conhecer), get to know (conhecer melhor), become friends (virar amigos), go out with (namorar), ask someone out (convidar para sair), fall in love with (apaixonar-se por), get engaged (ficar noivo), get married (casar-se)
Problemas
fall out with (brigar, romper), have an argument with (ter uma briga com), break up with / split up (terminar), lose touch with (perder contato)
Reconciliar
make up (fazer as pazes), keep in touch with (manter contato)
Bem
get on well with (se dar bem), look up to (admirar)
Pessoas
partner (parceiro), ex (ex-namorado, ex-marido), flatmate (colega de apartamento), colleague (colega de trabalho), neighbour (vizinho), best friend (melhor amigo), acquaintance (conhecido)

items: "I have a good relation with my boss." O certo é **relationship.**
"I discussed with my brother and we're not talking." O certo é **I had an argument with my brother** (ou: I argued with him). *Discuss* quer dizer discutir um assunto, não brigar.
"We left each other." O certo é **We broke up.**

I discussed with my brother yesterday and we're not talking.
acc: I had an argument with my brother yesterday and we're not talking
I had an argument with my brother yesterday and we are not talking

exercises.prompt: I have a good relation with my neighbours.
acc: I have a good relationship with my neighbours
I've a good relationship with my neighbours

lessons.title: Used to e would
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: used to / didn't use to; would para hábitos passados.

head: Forma
Uso
Exemplo
rows: used to + verbo
hábitos E estados do passado que já não existem
I used to play football every day. I used to have long hair.
would + verbo
só hábitos repetidos do passado, nunca estados
Every summer we would visit my grandparents.
didn't use to
negativa
I didn't use to like coffee.
Did you use to...?
pergunta
Did you use to live here?

items: Com estado (be, have, like, live, know) use **used to**, não would: *I used to be shy.*
Na negativa e na pergunta, o d some: **didn't use to**, **Did you use to...?**
Para o hábito atual use o presente simples: *I used to smoke, but now I don't.*
Cuidado: *used to + verbo* (passado) é diferente de *be used to + -ing* (estar acostumado). Este segundo você vê mais adiante na trilha.
"I use to play football when I was a kid." O certo é **I used to play.**
"I didn't used to like it." O certo é **I didn't use to like it.**
"When I was a kid, I would have a dog." O certo é **I used to have a dog.**

exercises.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ (play) in the street every afternoon.
I ___ (be) very shy, but now I'm outgoing.
I didn't used to like vegetables.
acc: I didn't use to like vegetables
I did not use to like vegetables

exercises.prompt: I use to go to the beach every weekend.
acc: I used to go to the beach every weekend

exercises.prompt: When I was a kid, I would have a dog.
acc: When I was a kid, I used to have a dog

lessons.title: Inglês prático, perguntas indiretas
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Perguntas indiretas (Could you tell me where...?).

head: Pergunta direta
Pergunta indireta (mais educada)
rows: Where is the bank?
Could you tell me where the bank is?
What time does it open?
Do you know what time it opens?
How much does it cost?
Can you tell me how much it costs?
Is there a pharmacy near here?
Do you know if there's a pharmacy near here?

aula.label: Regra
aula.text: Could you tell me / Do you know / I was wondering + palavra interrogativa + **ordem de frase afirmativa** (sujeito + verbo), sem do / does / did. Pergunta de sim ou não usa **if**.

items: "Could you tell me where is the bank?" O certo é **where the bank is.**
"Do you know what time does it open?" O certo é **what time it opens.**
"Could you tell me what did he say?" O certo é **what he said.**

acc: Could you tell me where the toilet is?

exercises.prompt: What time does the shop close?
acc: Do you know what time the shop closes?
Do you know if the bank is open?

exercises.prompt: Could you tell me where is the station?
acc: Could you tell me where the station is?
